("Image Scan" or the "Company")
Contract Award
New Orders for MDXi-400 Industrial X-ray Inspection Systems

Image Scan Holdings plc (AIM: IGE), the specialist provider of X-ray screening systems and security inspection technologies, is pleased to announce that its wholly owned subsidiary, 3DX-RAY Ltd, has received two new orders for its MDXi-400 X-ray inspection systems from an established customer in the automotive manufacturing sector.
The systems will be installed in Korea and Brazil and will support quality assurance and inspection processes for catalytic converter production.

These orders underline continuing demand for advanced industrial X-ray inspection technology in an automotive supply chain that remains active despite the broader transition towards vehicle electrification. Internal combustion engine manufacturing remains a significant global industry, and manufacturers continue to invest in production and inspection systems that help ensure the quality, consistency and reliability of catalytic converter components.
These latest orders will bring the number of 3DX-RAY systems supplied in this application to more than 65 worldwide.

Vincent Deery, Chief Executive Officer of Image Scan Holdings plc, said: "These latest orders demonstrate that demand for advanced X-ray inspection solutions in catalytic converter production continues. Despite wider discussion about the future of internal combustion engines, manufacturers continue to invest in quality assurance technologies that support efficient production and consistent product standards. We are delighted that an existing customer has once again selected the MDXi-400 platform."

ABOUT IMAGE SCAN HOLDINGS PLC
About Image Scan Holdings plc

Image Scan Holdings plc is a UK-based technology group specialising in security, defence and industrial X-ray imaging and sensing solutions. Through its 3DX-Ray brand, the Group designs, manufactures and supplies X-ray inspection systems used worldwide by military, law enforcement, bomb disposal and security organisations to detect threats and support counter-terrorism operations.

Following the acquisition of ClanTect Ltd, the Group has expanded its technology portfolio to include human presence detection systems. ClanTect's products are deployed at secure facilities, critical infrastructure sites and border crossings to detect concealed individuals within vehicles and enhance perimeter security.
All these products are taken to market across the world through a strong network of international partners.

In addition, Image Scan manufactures industrial X-ray inspection systems. The primary market for these systems is in automotive emissions control where they are used for quality control inspection of catalytic converters and diesel particulate filters.
